name: Gentian Observation Diary
source:
Same faces, same rumors, same death threats, same childish yet absurdly cruel pranks pulled on children in the tiny world known (ironically) as Koufuku High ruled by the same kind of people every year, it's a terrible drag, a horrid, horrid drag! 

That's why, you've decided to stake your demise on the only girl still standing strong enough to even defend herself, isn't it? Hanamura Tsubaki.

[From [url=https://shinitai-tan.itch.io/gentian-observation-diary]itch.io[/url]]
